_comment: Edit and save. padctl reloads live, no restart. A typo keeps the last good config instead of crashing.

_actions.keys: { type: keys, keys: [enter, ctrl+u, shift+tab, esc, up, ...] } -> focused pane
_actions.text: { type: text, text: <string>, submit: true|false } -> focused pane
_actions.agent: { type: agent, dir: next|prev }  cycles agent panes only, skipping workspaces that have none
_actions.hotkey: { type: hotkey, key: enter|escape|<code>, modifiers: [command,shift,option,control] } -> SYSTEM-WIDE, works in any app
_actions.hold: { type: hold, button: left|right } -> SYSTEM-WIDE. Down on press, up on release: tap = click, keep held = drag.
_actions._repeat: Add "repeat": true to any action to make holding the button fire it again, like a held keyboard key. Tune with repeat_delay_ms (default 400) and repeat_ms (default 60).

_controls: south east west north dpad_up dpad_down dpad_left dpad_right l1 r1 l2 r2 l3 r3 menu view touchpad lstick_up lstick_down lstick_left lstick_right rstick_up rstick_down rstick_left rstick_right  (l1 is the layer modifier, never bindable)  |  touchpad swipes: swipe_left swipe_right swipe_up swipe_down  (+ _x2 on any of them for a double swipe, e.g. swipe_up_x2. A direction only waits for a second swipe if its _x2 is bound.)

north._note: Fakes a bare right-Option press, which is Spokenly's own shortcut, so its native toggle gives start AND stop from one button. The spokenly://start URL only ever starts. Needs Accessibility for whichever process posts the event.
north.cmd: osascript -e 'tell application "System Events" to key code 61'

swipe_up_x2._note: Mission Control, same as a three-finger swipe up on the trackpad.

lstick_up.text: Review this diff. Flag what is actually broken, cite file:line. Skip the nitpicks.

lstick_down.text: Something is broken. Ask me what is failing and what I already tried, then find the root cause before touching anything.

dpad_left.text: Clean this up without changing behaviour. Simpler, not cleverer.

dpad_right.text: Write tests for what I just changed. Cover the edge cases that would actually bite.

_desktop: desktop_bindings override `bindings` whenever the frontmost app is NOT terminal_bundle. L1 layer always wins. Anything not listed here falls back to `bindings`.
_chords: Optional. e.g. {"l2+r2": {...}}. Both presses must land within 140ms of each other AND stay held 250ms. Buttons in a chord get a 140ms delay on their solo action; buttons in none stay instant. Empty = no chords, no delay anywhere.

l2+r2._note: Screenshot to clipboard. Safe to chord: a stray one costs nothing.
